sfx.what: Any button or bubble tapped: a soft "pop"
Close / back: the pop in reverse
A panel or card slides open: a bubbly "bloop"
A setting switched on: two notes up
A setting switched off: two notes down
One coin picked up
Results counter ticking up (pitch rises as it counts)
Counter reached its number: bright "ding"
Coins counter: tiny coin clinks while counting
Coins drop into the coin jar
New best score stamp: a happy fanfare
Something bought with coins: "ka-ching!"
Something bought with Gems: a sparkly rising chime
"Are you sure?" pop-up for Gems
Can’t do that (not enough coins, locked): a soft "uh-uh"
Mystery Box wiggles on the conveyor: rattle
Box bursts open: "pop!" plus a whoosh
Reveal: Common (2 friendly notes)
Reveal: Uncommon (3 notes)
Reveal: Rare (bells arpeggio)
Reveal: Epic (arpeggio + shimmer)
Reveal: Legendary (full fanfare)
Duplicate goes to the Spare Shelf: "boop-boop"
A Sparkly pull: glitter on top of the reveal
Renovating a house: 3 hammer knocks…
…and the "ta-da!" when it is done
Something new unlocked: magic chime up
Quest finished: "ding-dong"
A star earned
A heart lost in a minigame
Squishing a squishy: a soft squelch
Squishy bounces back: "boing"
Camera flies to a building
Story: the Big Grumble Wind
Story: a far-away rumble (never scary-loud)
Magic sparkle (story, Gem Challenge done)
An ad the player chose is about to play
Bao says hi (tutorial guide speaking)
